Package wellen

Class BeatMIDI

java.lang.Object
wellen.BeatMIDI
All Implemented Interfaces:
MidiInListener
public class BeatMIDI extends Object implements MidiInListener
similar to Beat except that beat events are triggered by an external MIDI clock signal.

the method beat(int) of the listener is called for every MIDI clock pulse ( 24 pulses per quarter note ). the first pulse after a MIDI start message is beat 0. after a song position pointer message the next pulse is the beat at that position ( one sixteenth note = 6 pulses ).

by default beat(int) is called on the MIDI thread. use dispatch_on_draw_thread(boolean) to call it on the processing animation thread instead.

      @Deprecated public static boolean LEGACY_BEAT_COUNT
      Deprecated.
      only use this to keep old sketches working that rely on the old ( wrong ) counting.
      if true the beat counter behaves like before v0.14: the first beat after a MIDI start message is 1 instead of 0.

    • dispatch_on_draw_thread

      public BeatMIDI dispatch_on_draw_thread(boolean dispatch_on_draw_thread)
      Parameters:
      dispatch_on_draw_thread - if true beat(int) is queued and called on the processing animation thread right before draw(). this is safer when drawing or changing sketch state in beat(int) but beats are delivered in batches once per frame. requires the listener to be a PApplet.
      Returns:
      BeatMIDI
